events.title: Controller: slide moves to LB
events.summary: A small update for everyone playing with a controller. Slide moved to LB Slide used to be on RB, right next to RT, which you hold to accelerate. Sliding meant letting go of RT, and your slime slowed down. Slide is now on LB, so your left hand slides while your right hand keeps RT held. Aim: next target moves to RB. Prefer the old layout? Change it any time in Settings > Controls. Keyboard controls are unchanged. Tell us how it feels Come and tell us on Discord: https://discord.gg/HGkNZpTzt6 Than

events.title: Crash fix for older graphics cards, and added tutorial prompts
events.summary: Thanks to everyone who played the demo. This update fixes the crash we have seen on Windows, and adds tutorial prompts to races. Crash fix Fixed a crash on some older NVIDIA and AMD graphics cards on Windows. The Medium and High presets now use FXAA anti-aliasing by default to avoid it. You can still choose MSAA yourself in Settings > Graphics. If you turned Anti-aliasing off to work around the crash, just pick your Preset again in Settings > Graphics. events.title: MELT DOWN demo is out now
events.summary: The demo is live You are a slime, and from the moment the race begins you are melting. Melting makes you smaller, eventually turning you into a puddle. But the smaller you get, the faster you go. Avoid traps, environmental hazards, and rivals who are going to try and stop you from finishing the race. Use the powers to get back at your rivals and turn the tables or boost yourself to the finish line. You have the powa! What is in it A full cup of four tracks: Meadow, Scorch, Gauntlet and the Rift.

events.title: Demo out October 7
events.summary: Melt Down, our slime racing game, is coming out with it's demo on October 7. The MELT DOWN demo has four tracks, three rivals, and a countdown made of your own body. You start melting at the start of each race.
